instructions: Use tools/list and tools/call to retrieve Tandem documentation guidance.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the published Tandem docs index for relevant pages.

query.description: The Tandem question, task, or keyword query to search for.

docs_ref.description: Docs channel or immutable ref. Defaults to stable. Use next, refs/<sha>, or releases/<version> only when explicitly needed.

engine_version.description: Optional Tandem engine version hint. If supplied without docs_ref, the MCP still defaults to stable unless a matching versioned docs ref is configured.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching docs pages to return.

audience.description: Optional audience filter such as developer, desktop user, or operator.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Fetch and normalize a published Tandem docs page by path or URL.

path.description: Docs path like /sdk/python/ or a full Tandem docs URL.

docs_ref.description: Docs channel or immutable ref. Defaults to stable.

engine_version.description: Optional Tandem engine version hint for compatibility checks.

tools.name: get_start_path
tools.description: Recommend the best Tandem docs starting path for a desktop user, server admin, or developer.

role.description: The user role to optimize the docs starting point for.

docs_ref.description: Docs channel or immutable ref. Defaults to stable.

tools.name: recommend_next_docs
tools.description: Recommend the next Tandem docs to read after a current page, optionally biased toward a goal.

current_path.description: Current Tandem docs path the user has already read.

docs_ref.description: Docs channel or immutable ref. Defaults to stable.

goal.description: Optional goal such as install Tandem, use the Python SDK, or build workflows.

limit.description: Maximum number of next-doc recommendations to return.

tools.name: answer_how_to
tools.description: Answer how to install or use Tandem, build workflows, or use the SDKs by synthesizing relevant published docs.

task.description: The Tandem task or question that needs a docs-grounded answer.

docs_ref.description: Docs channel or immutable ref. Defaults to stable.

engine_version.description: Optional Tandem engine version hint. Prefer stable docs for installed engines.

audience.description: Optional audience hint such as developer, desktop user, or operator.

limit.description: Maximum number of supporting docs recommendations to include.

tools.name: get_tandem_guide
tools.description: Return a structured Tandem learning guide for install-engine, python-sdk, typescript-sdk, build-workflows, or headless-deploy.

topic.description: Named Tandem learning guide to return.

docs_ref.description: Docs channel or immutable ref. Defaults to stable.

tools.name: warmup_docs_cache
tools.description: Refresh the docs index and preload the most important Tandem docs pages into cache.

force_refresh.description: Whether to bypass cache and force fresh upstream fetches first.

docs_ref.description: Docs channel or immutable ref. Defaults to stable.

tools.name: get_docs_cache_status
tools.description: Inspect the current docs cache state for index sources and warmed pages.

tools.name: refresh_docs_index
tools.description: Force-refresh docs indexes and report whether data came from the network, cache, or stale fallback.

force_refresh.description: Whether to bypass cache and force a network refresh attempt.

docs_ref.description: Docs channel or immutable ref. Defaults to stable.

tools.name: refresh_doc_page
tools.description: Force-refresh a docs page and report whether content came from the network, cache, or stale fallback.

path.description: Docs path like /start-here/ or /sdk/python/ to refresh.

docs_ref.description: Docs channel or immutable ref. Defaults to stable.

force_refresh.description: Whether to bypass cache and force a network refresh attempt.

tools.name: invalidate_docs_cache
tools.description: Invalidate docs cache entries for index data, all pages, or a specific page path.

path.description: Required when target is page; identifies the specific docs path to invalidate.

docs_ref.description: Optional docs ref to scope page/index cache invalidation.

tools.name: compare_docs_index_refresh
tools.description: Force-refresh the docs indexes and return before/after hashes so content changes can be proven.

docs_ref.description: Docs channel or immutable ref. Defaults to stable.

tools.name: compare_doc_page_refresh
tools.description: Force-refresh a docs page and return before/after hashes so page content changes can be proven.

path.description: Docs path like /start-here/ or /sdk/python/ to compare before and after refresh.

docs_ref.description: Docs channel or immutable ref. Defaults to stable.
